notes.title: PBBGU - Patch V.1.04.4141

notes.title: PBBGU - Patch V.1.03.3459
notes.content:
Hey Players!

Thanks for continuing to battle with us in Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate! This hotfix rolls out a handful of key improvements and bug fixes to keep your experience running smooth and solid:

[u][b]Enemy Clearing Fix[/b][/u]
[i]Resolved an issue where certain enemies weren’t being properly counted, which could prevent progression in some areas.[/i]

[u][b]Ranking Display Tweak[/b][/u]
[i]The leaderboard now correctly caps at 999 entries as originally intended. Keep climbing and make your mark among the top![/i]

[u][b]Steam Offline Launch Support[/b][/u]
[i]The game now boots normally on Steam while offline—as long as your Steam client is running.[/i]

[u][b]Throw Attack Adjustments[/b][/u]
[i]Fixed an issue where enemies could become stuck after being hit with a strike throw.
If a character is damaged mid-throw, the game now handles it correctly without freezing.
[/i]
[u][b]Additional Stability Updates[/b][/u]
[i]Improved error handling to prevent edge-case progression blockers and online play disruptions.[/i]

Thanks again for all the support and feedback—you help us keep pushing PB:BGU to the next level! 

Happy gaming,

[i]- The Rocket Panda Team 🐼[/i]

notes.title: PHANTOM BREAKER : BATTLE GROUND ULTIMATE IS NOW LIVE !!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Finally, it’s launch day for PHANTOM BREAKER: Battle Ground Ultimate![/b][/h2]

A huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to the Panda community and all Phantom Breaker fans for your incredible support! Your feedback was the fuel behind our passion.

After so much sweat, tears, and way too much coffee, we’re beyond proud to finally share this game with you.

Rebuilt entirely from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, [b]Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate[/b] brings slicker combos, flashier specials, and smoother action than ever before. Jump into the chaos with up to 8 players online, cross-platform, so you can bring the fight with your friends, no matter where they play.

With all characters from classic [b]PB:BG and Overdrive[/b] returning, new gameplay systems, remastered music (or classic tracks if you're feeling nostalgic), and the ability to fight as enemies... this is a complete reimagining of the game you love.

Now it’s time to grab your controllers and show them what you’ve got.

We’re truly grateful—and we hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we loved making it. 

[i]— The Rocket Panda Team[/i]

notes.title: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate (Nintendo Switch) Review
notes.content:
Playing Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate for the purposes of this review made me realize two things. First, I don’t think I was ever aware of Phantom Breaker. I think that may be forgivable, though—I mean, how many of you reading this review have heard of it before now? I’ve probably mentioned before that, despite always liking them, I was never a big fighting game aficionado, lacking the skill to play games like Street Fighter or Tekken at higher levels.

Second, despite really loving the beat ’em up genre, I’ve never branched out much beyond a handful of favourites—Castle Crashers, Scott Pilgrim vs. The World: The Game and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Turtles in Time, most notably. So I’m always excited to check out new and interesting beat ’em ups when they come around, and honestly, Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate may be one of the most fun beat ’em ups I’ve played in a long time.

notes.title: Important Announcement From Game Producer Masaki Sakari
notes.content:
Dear Rocket Panda Games community and Phantom Breaker fans,

We have an important announcement from our game producer Masaki Sakari in regards to the launch of Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate.

To all of our fans, supporters, and beloved Phantom Breaker community,

The release date for Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate, originally scheduled for Thursday, February 13, 2025, has been postponed to Thursday, April 17, 2025.

First and foremost, we want to extend our sincerest apologies to you—everyone eagerly awaiting the game’s release. While the single-player experience is nearly complete, we encountered unforeseen delays with the implementation and testing of the online modes. Enabling online cross-play multiplayer across all platforms (Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Nintendo Switch) is an incredibly challenging feature, but we’re committed to our mission of letting our awesome fans play together at launch.

The delay is entirely my responsibility as the producer. We kindly ask for your patience until the new release date of April 17.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Sincerely,

Masaki Sakari (Sakari P)

With the launch of PBBGU pushed back to April 17, 2025, we want to thank you for your patience and understanding while we work to and are committed to release the best game we can for our community.
